summary: Adds a new machine-based Fanuc post-processor ("fanuc") with Fanuc defaults for the common Machine output properties and eight post-specific Machine/Job properties (program number, tape marks, upper-case, dwell in ms, rigid tapping M29, parametric TLO, empty-spindle park and its retract); the legacy fanuc_legacy post is untouched and only its test suite is renamed.

pages.reason: Path/Post/scripts/fanuc_post.py: new FanucPost(PostProcessor) with POST_TYPE='machine'; get_property_schema() defines program_number (job), wrap_in_percent, uppercase_output, dwell_in_milliseconds, rigid_tapping, tool_length_offset_macro, end_spindle_empty (job), end_spindle_empty_retract; get_common_property_schema() overrides defaults (file_extension 'nc', preamble 'G17 G54 G40 G49 G80 G90 G94', postamble, pre_tool_change, spindle_decimals 0, drill_cycles_to_translate empty, supports_tool_radius_compensation True, parameter_order without K); ROTATION_STRATEGIES ('dwo','twp'), PLANE_COMMAND G68.2; no page documents this post

Path/Post/scripts/fanuc_post.py added and registered in CMakeLists.txt PathPythonPostScripts_SRCS: the list of included post-processors gains a machine-based 'fanuc' alongside the existing 'fanuc_legacy'

Path/Post/scripts/fanuc_post.py: new machine-based post that the 'Other existing Post-Processors' inventory should list; it is also a worked example of overriding get_common_property_schema() defaults and adding get_property_schema() entries with SCOPE_MACHINE/SCOPE_JOB
